new_nodes.label: Public Component Data Scope
new_nodes.statement: The inspected public Ruttle, Mostafa and Le Franc routes support separate visuomotor/localization or tendon-vibration/visual-context components, but none jointly observes the exact R161 q-by-r crossing, both R161 readouts and active-versus-bony vibration contrast in the same participants.
new_nodes.domain: Exactly the three primary source/data routes inspected in R162; not an exhaustive registry search or a universal absence claim.
new_nodes.scope: Exactly the three primary source/data routes inspected in R162; not an exhaustive registry search or a universal absence claim.
new_nodes.source_lineage: R161 component sources plus their primary data-availability statements.
new_nodes.proof: Typed source/method comparison recorded in SOURCE_LEDGER.json; no raw-file reanalysis claimed.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An undiscovered exact crossed dataset would supersede this finite audit but not the separate-marginal covariance theorem.

new_nodes.label: Separate-Marginal Covariance Non-Identification
new_nodes.statement: Separate datasets identifying only marginal laws of required contrast blocks do not generally identify cross covariance or dominance-difference precision. Unit marginal variances and rho in [-1,1] preserve both marginals while Var(U-V)=2-2rho ranges over [0,4].
new_nodes.domain: Required contrast components or blocks observed only in disjoint samples, absent a supplied joint-coupling assumption.
new_nodes.scope: Required contrast components or blocks observed only in disjoint samples, absent a supplied joint-coupling assumption.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Elementary covariance algebra applied to the R161 eight-effect uncertainty object.
new_nodes.proof: The 2-by-2 Sigma_rho family is positive semidefinite for every rho in [-1,1] and preserves both unit-variance marginals; exact checks cover nine rational rho values and endpoints 0,4.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A jointly measured W vector or independently justified coupling model can identify/restrict covariance; setting rho=0 is extra.

new_nodes.label: Independent Pilot Freeze Contract
new_nodes.statement: Run the exact R161 protocol in a disjoint external pilot; return only nuisance covariance, variance bounds, completion/fidelity and diagnostic summaries; hide means and R161 labels; freeze the complete confirmatory plan; never pool pilot participants into primary confirmatory intervals. Failed gates yield PILOT_INVALID_PROTOCOL and excessive required N yields DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE.
new_nodes.domain: Prospective ethics-approved implementation of the fixed R161 protocol; no pilot, ethics approval or recruitment occurred in R162.
new_nodes.scope: Prospective ethics-approved implementation of the fixed R161 protocol; no pilot, ethics approval or recruitment occurred in R162.
new_nodes.source_lineage: UCT I no-rescue discipline, R161 admissibility and established external/internal-pilot methods.
new_nodes.proof: Definition. Gaussian variance-UCB precision and planning equations are conditional components, not empirical validation.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An internal pilot reusing subjects needs separate adaptive calibration; blinding alone is insufficient; Gaussianity and missingness are open.

new_nodes.label: Planwise Conditional Coverage Premise
new_nodes.statement: For every pilot record in the declared support and every frozen plan selected from it, the interval procedure applied to independent confirmatory data has conditional simultaneous coverage at least 1-alpha under the declared model and target population.
new_nodes.domain: Every plan in the range of the prospective pilot-selection map for one fixed R161 protocol version and declared target population.
new_nodes.scope: Every plan in the range of the prospective pilot-selection map for one fixed R161 protocol version and declared target population.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Explicit premise isolated during R162 all_of audit; simple Gaussian fallback conditionally discharges it via fixed Bonferroni Student intervals.
new_nodes.proof: Not a theorem of independence. It is a required premise; §6 supplies a conditional discharge only for complete i.i.d. multivariate-Gaussian vectors and the frozen Bonferroni Student family.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Independent confirmatory data do not repair a misspecified interval, invalid missingness rule or unproved adaptive interval family.

new_nodes.label: Coverage Under Independent Pilot Freezing
new_nodes.statement: If a pilot-selected plan is frozen before independent confirmatory data and every plan in the selection range has conditional simultaneous coverage at least 1-alpha, then the randomly selected plan has unconditional simultaneous coverage at least 1-alpha. The declared absolute-value interval transform preserves coverage before applying R161 min/max aggregation.
new_nodes.domain: One fixed R161 protocol version; disjoint pilot/confirmatory records or another valid conditional-calibration theorem; all six gates; declared complete-vector target/model.
new_nodes.scope: One fixed R161 protocol version; disjoint pilot/confirmatory records or another valid conditional-calibration theorem; all six gates; declared complete-vector target/model.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Tower property, interval image under absolute value, and R161's fixed decision logic.
new_nodes.proof: Take expectation of plan-conditional coverage over the pilot record; interval image contains the absolute truth whenever the signed interval covers. Exact checks cover 700 finite pilot/confirm pairs and 165 signed-interval cases.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Same-data adaptive tail selection doubles .05 to .10 in the saved witness. The theorem does not validate Gaussianity, missingness, bootstrap calibration or fidelity.

new_rules.statement: Given the R161 joint eight-contrast requirement and component datasets that do not jointly observe its blocks, marginal source data alone do not identify the cross covariance or dominance-difference precision.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Instantiate the Sigma_rho family on one unpaired target/cross pair; every rho preserves the observed marginals while changing Var(U-V).

new_rules.statement: The frozen R161 decision, disjoint pilot contract and explicit planwise conditional-coverage premise jointly yield unconditional simultaneous coverage and a coverage-preserving route to the R161 magnitude/min-max decision.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Tower property over the pilot-selected plan followed by the deterministic absolute-interval image lemma.
